description: The 4StoreyBuilding building model is open in eQUEST. This is a real multi-storey commercial building model with multiple thermal zones. Run the DOE-2.2 energy simulation by clicking 'Simulate Building Performance' in the Actions panel on the left side of the screen. This will launch the DOE-2.2 simulation engine, which may take 30-60 seconds to complete. A simulation progress window will appear and close when done. Once the simulation finishes, view the annual energy consumption results by clicking 'Review Simulation Results View' in the Actions panel. This opens the results viewer showing the energy summary report with total annual energy consumption broken down by end use (heating, cooling, lighting, equipment, fans, pumps).
